svg.metadata: Generated from the accepted Mary-O v2 anatomy. Primitive Components are the single editable geometry authority and are normalized to SVG paths. Component Assemblies and final rig views are clone-derived and locked by default in Inkscape. Pivot helpers remain hidden inside Rig Guides groups. Python owns transient effects.
